verdict.rationale: The only policy-related evidence is a passing mention that the SOC 2 Launchpad lets you 'action policies'. Nothing in the pack documents a lawyer-grade policy template library, a policy editor, versioning, approval workflows, or per-employee acceptance tracking. The GitHub GDPR document pack is a code-scan skill that generates GDPR documents, which is a different capability from a policy management module, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking
